note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: none on this branch: both findings are taken as an immediate follow-up on test/hatch-bash-oracle, checked by the real-bash oracle — a link (ln, link) makes source and destination one file, so any unknowable operand of a link counts as written somewhere unknown (codex); a destination given by -t or --target-directory is read from the option instead of taken as the last operand (qwen).
rounds.notes: Landing round. 6 of 6 returned verdicts: 4 SOUND (antigravity, deepseek, glm, minimax), 2 NOT SOUND. Codex's false grant is an alias built through an unknowable name — the class three of the SOUND reviewers explicitly scope as deliberate construction; Qwen's is a rare false deny. Neither meets the landing bar of an accidental false grant or an everyday false deny, so this tip lands as reviewed and both are fixed in the follow-up rather than reopening the loop.
